title: "crossmap explorer"

## What this is

A companion to [`xmap`](https://github.com/cynthiahqy/xmap)'s vignettes
and to the crossmaps definition paper
([Huang 2024, arXiv:2406.14163](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2406.14163)),
extending the "exploratory power of a crossmap collection" idea onto the
full, real INDSTAT Rev.3 extract -- using `isiccomb` combination-code
splitting as a running case study. See `CLAUDE.md` for the full
architecture writeup.

This site is deliberately a linear set of Quarto notebooks, not a data
pipeline with a build tool behind it: [Extraction](00-extract-crossmaps.qmd)
runs the vignette's naive-weight extraction technique once and saves a
single `crossmap_collection.rds` artifact; every other page just reads
that file.

- [Extraction](00-extract-crossmaps.qmd) -- the naive-weight ("carbon
  paper") extraction + per-country-year validation, on real data
- [Coverage](01-coverage-tiles.qmd) -- which country-years rely on a
  split at all, and how much
- [Explorer](02-crossmap-explorer.qmd) -- zoom into one country-year's
  `isiccomb -> isic -> isic.3` crossmap as a node-link diagram
- [Country variants](03-country-variants.qmd) -- all the structurally
  distinct crossmaps a single country used over time
- [Composed overview](04-composed-overview.qmd) -- the whole-classification
  `isiccomb -> isic.3` structure, composed via `xmap::compose_xmap()`
